spans.s:
अशेव अ-शेव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pernicious,
dangerous, not causing pleasure.

आ-सेवा, f. zealous cultivation of any pursuit; com-
merce, intercourse.

अशेष अ-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, without remainder,
entire, perfect, all, whole, every; infinite, endless; (अस्),
m. non-remainder; अशेषम् or अशेषेण or अशेष-
तस्, ind. entirely, wholly.
—अशेष-ता, f. totality.
—अशेष-साम्राज्य, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.

अशेषय, nom. P. अशेषयति, -यितुम्, to finish
entirely.

अ-शेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. without offspring or de-
scendants.

असेचन अ-सेचन or अ-सेचनक, अस्, आ, अम्,
that on which one cannot look enough; charming,
lovely [cf. आ-सेचनक].

आ-सेचन, अम्, n. the act of pouring into, wetting,
sprinkling; Ved. a reservoir or vessel for fluids;
(अस्, ई, अम्), charming, lovely, beloved [cf. अ-सेचन,
for which it may be a substitute].
—आसेचन-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, containing a reservoir or cavity, hollow,
concave.

असेन्य अ-सेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not worthy
of an army; not striking, not wounding (?).

असेवन अ-सेवन, अम्, n. or अ-सेवा, f. (rt.
[]
सेव्), disregarding, neglecting; not following or prac-
tising, shunning; disregard, inattention, disobedience.

आ-सेवन, अम्, n. assiduous practice or performance
of any action.

अ-सेवित, अस्, आ, अम्, neglected, unattended to, dis-
obeyed; abstained from, disused.
—अ-सेवितेश्वर-
द्वार (˚त-ईश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, not waiting at the
doors of the great.

अ-सेव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be served or attended
to; not to be used or practised, not to be eaten,
drank, &c.

आशेकुटिन् आशेकुटिन्, ई, m. a mountain
(etymology doubtful).
आ-सेक, अस्, m. wetting, sprinkling, pouring in.

आसेचनक, अस्, आ, अम् (?), beloved, desired, charm-
ing [cf. अ-सेचन].

आ-सेद्धृ, धा, m. one who confines or arrests
another.

आ-सेध, अस्, m. arrest, custody, legal restraint of
four kinds, viz. कालासेध, limitation of time; स्था-
नासेध, confinement to a place; प्रवासासेध,
prohibition against removal or departure; कर्मा-
सेध, restriction from employment.
आसेध आ-सेध. See 2. आ-सिद्ध last col.
आ-सेधक, अस्, आ, अम्, restraining, confining.

आ-सेधनीय or आ-सेध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed
in custody, restrained, confined, prohibited, interrupted.

आसेव् आ-सेव्, cl. 1. A. or poet. P. -सेवते,
-ति, -वितुम्, to attend to, accomplish; carry out,
practice, perform assiduously; to indulge in, enjoy.
आ-सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, performing assiduously, acting.
